title: AI governance in practice

parts.head: CODIFY · CenterStart
parts.body: Experts write their judgment down as policy. Sales sets discount limits. Legal sets standard clauses.

text: New and changed policies cross here.
parts.recorded: each policy, who set it, who approved it and why.

parts.head: COMPANY A'S SPACE · CenterSquare
parts.body: The shared context: the experts' policies, pricing, past contracts and the customer's history. Sales and Legal each add their team's policies.

text: The salesperson's CenterEye may read the Sales part of Company A's space.

parts.head: THE ASK · CONTEXT · CenterEye
parts.body: The salesperson asks their agent for a contract. Their CenterEye adds Company A's shared context and their own accounts and history.

text: The gate reads the ask's intent:

parts.head: THE DRAFT
parts.body: The salesperson's agent drafts the contract from the company's context and the salesperson's own.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: The agent asks Salesforce for the customer's details through an MCP connector.

text: Sales may read its own accounts in Salesforce.

parts.head: SCOPE · CenterSquare
parts.body: Approval limits flow down: 25% for the Sales team and 10% for the salesperson. The draft asks for 20%.

text: 20% is over the salesperson's 10% and under the team's 25%. The request escalates to the sales manager.
parts.recorded: the manager approved 20%. Why: a multi-year deal.

parts.head: SALES MANAGER
parts.body: Sees the request and its reason. Approves 20%.

text: Sales may hand Legal a draft. Policy: no contract leaves Company A without Legal's review.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: Legal's agent reviews the draft and flags a non-standard clause. After the lawyer's approval it sends the draft out.

text: A non-standard liability clause escalates to the lawyer.

parts.head: LAWYER
parts.body: Sees the clause and its reason. Approves it.

text: Legal's agent also attached the customer's full Salesforce record. Policy: customer records can't leave Company A. The draft goes on without it.
The draft may go to the customer's Legal team for review.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: The customer's Legal team reviews under its own policies and sends back changes.

text: The customer's changes comply with Company A's policies.
Over the quarter the same 20% exception was approved three times. The Sales expert gets one question: should multi-year deals get 20% without approval?

parts.head: BACK TO CODIFY · CenterStart
parts.body: The Sales expert updates the discount policy: multi-year deals can go to 20% without approval. The head of Sales approves the change.

pieces.name: CODIFY · CenterStart
pieces.line: Turn an expert's judgment into policy an AI can follow.

pieces.name: CONTEXT · CenterEye
pieces.line: Each AI a person uses gets the same context: the company's and their own.

pieces.name: SCOPE · CenterSquare
pieces.line: Company policies flow down to the groups and people they apply to.

pieces.name: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
pieces.line: Carries work and messages between people, agents and outside systems.

pieces.name: GOVERN · CenterGovern
pieces.line: Every step is enforced, traced, auditable and accountable. The intent behind each decision is kept as it changes.

gate_lines: Each handoff between people, agents, teams or companies passes through a policy gate.
The gate reads the intent: who, what, why, on whose authority, until when.
It enforces the policies in scope and records the decision with its reason.

outcomes.line: a person in the loop decides.
a repeated exception goes back to the experts.

record.head: THE AUDIT TRAIL · CenterGovern
record.body: Each gate writes here: what was asked, the policies applied, the outcome, who decided and why. Later changes to the intent are kept too.

loop.head: ON THE LOOP
loop.body: Others on the deal monitor the audit trail and get alerts. Any of them can step in.
